title: Michoacán to Distribute 10,000 Artisanal Guitars in Secondary Schools to Boost Arts Education
author: Ernesto Martínez Elorriaga
content:
_This article by[Ernesto Martínez
Elorriaga](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Ernesto%20Mart%C3%ADnez%20Elorriaga,%20Corresponsal%C2%A0)
originally appeared in the [September 11, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/11/estados/michoacan-
distribuira-10-mil-guitarras-artesanales-en-secundarias-para-impulsar-la-
educacion-artistica), Mexico’s premier left-wing daily newspaper._

**Morelia, Michoacán**. To promote arts education and support the artisans of
Paracho, **10,000 guitars will be distributed** in the secondary schools of
the state’s 113 municipalities; of these instruments, 500 study models will go
to teachers who lead artistic activities. This action is part of the Michoacán
Plan for Peace and Justice and will generate a direct economic impact in the
municipality of Paracho, benefiting the families and workers of 15 artisanal
workshops dedicated to making this emblematic instrument, reported Governor
Alfredo Ramírez Bedolla.

![](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/paracho-guitar-
body.jpg)A guitar handmade in Paracho, Michoacán. Photo: Andmedpin / Wikimedia
Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

A total of **180,000 students** from 613 schools across the state will
benefit. More than 400 families will be helped. The program was allocated **10
million pesos** , the state governor noted.

![](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/michoacan-guitars-
student-body.jpg)A student plays guitar in the ensemble. Photo: La Jornada

Ramírez Bedolla explained that the program was agreed a year ago in
coordination with President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo, with the aim of
supporting the economy of the artisans who have kept alive this centuries-old
tradition that gives Michoacán its identity.
